common_parameters.name: api_key
common_parameters.description: Required. Private API key from the account page.

common_parameters.name: engine
common_parameters.description: Which engine to use (google, google_light, bing, ...). Google is the default on the Google search page.

common_parameters.name: output
common_parameters.description: Response format.

common_parameters.name: json_restrictor
common_parameters.description: Restrict which fields of the JSON are returned to reduce payload size and speed up responses (e.g. 'organic_results[].title').

common_parameters.name: no_cache
common_parameters.description: false (default) allows cached results; true forces a fresh fetch. Cache is served only when query and all parameters are identical, expires after 1 hour, and cached searches are free. Must not be combined with async.

common_parameters.name: async
common_parameters.description: false (default) holds the connection until results arrive; true returns immediately with search_metadata only and results are fetched later via the Search Archive API. Do not use on accounts with Ludicrous Speed enabled, and do not combine with no_cache.

common_parameters.name: zero_trace
common_parameters.description: Enterprise only. When true SerpApi does not store search parameters, files or metadata (harder to debug; archive retrieval unavailable).

common_parameters.name: device
common_parameters.description: Device to emulate.

common_parameters.name: q
common_parameters.description: Query (required by most search engines; error 'Missing query q parameter' otherwise).

common_parameters.name: location
common_parameters.description: Human readable location (canonical name from the Locations API). Cannot be combined with uule, lat or lon.

common_parameters.name: uule
common_parameters.description: Google-encoded location. Cannot be combined with location.

common_parameters.name: lat / lon
common_parameters.description: Coordinates, must be used together; pair with a matching gl.

common_parameters.name: radius
common_parameters.description: Radius around lat/lon: 1..199 on desktop, 1..1000 on tablet and mobile.

common_parameters.name: google_domain
common_parameters.description: Google-family engines only (not global). Default google.com.

common_parameters.name: gl
common_parameters.description: Country code (Google engines).

common_parameters.name: hl
common_parameters.description: Interface language (Google engines).

common_parameters.name: lr / cr
common_parameters.description: Restrict result languages / countries (Google engines).

common_parameters.name: safe
common_parameters.description: Adult content filter.

common_parameters.name: nfpr
common_parameters.description: 1 excludes auto-corrected results, 0 includes (default).

common_parameters.name: filter
common_parameters.description: 1 (default) enables similar/omitted results filters, 0 disables.

common_parameters.name: start
common_parameters.description: Result offset for pagination (0, 10, 20...).

common_parameters.name: tbm
common_parameters.description: Google search type (isch, lcl, vid, nws, shop, pts).

common_parameters.name: tbs
common_parameters.description: Advanced Google filters (time range, etc.).

common_parameters.name: color_scheme
common_parameters.description: light or dark (random if unset); Google engine only.

common_parameters.name: engine=google_light
common_parameters.description: 'Light' variant of Google: faster organic results, knowledge graphs and answer boxes, skipping some special result types. Same endpoint /search; supports device, output, json_restrictor, no_cache, async, zero_trace.

common_parameters.name: Ludicrous Speed (plan option)
common_parameters.description: Not a request parameter. Enabled under Dashboard > Change Plan on paid plans; costs 2x Best Effort; about 2.2x faster on average, 4.2x at p99 (SerpApi's own numbers); priority network, parallel requests, validators discard CAPTCHA/error pages. Do not use async with it.

common_parameters.name: Ludicrous Speed Max (plan option)
common_parameters.description: Account option at 4x Best Effort price, 4x resources of Ludicrous Speed, 9.6 percent faster p50 and 35.4 percent faster p99 than Ludicrous Speed (SerpApi's numbers). Paid plans only.

metadata_fields.note: The docs reviewed did not show a literal search_metadata block; field names below follow the task list and standard SerpApi responses. Only id and status are described in public docs; the rest are [unverified] meanings.

search_metadata.description: Search id used with the Search Archive API (/searches/{id}).
Queued, Processing, Success, Error. 'Cached' also appears for cache hits.
[unverified meaning] URL to fetch this search's JSON from the archive.
[unverified meaning] When the search was created.
[unverified meaning] Upstream engine URL that was fetched (engine-specific name).
[unverified meaning] Link to the raw HTML captured.

metadata_fields.search_parameters: Echo of the parameters the search ran with (engine, q, location_requested, location_used, google_domain, hl, gl, device) [unverified exact keys]; plus no_cache/async as sent.

search_information.description: Query as displayed by the engine.
Engine-displayed time, parsed to a number.

metadata_fields.top_level_error_key: On failures or empty results the JSON contains an 'error' string (e.g. 'Google hasn't returned any results for this query.').

account_api.endpoint: GET https://serpapi.com/account.json  (docs example also shows https://serpapi.com/account?api_key=...)
account_api.cost: Free; does not count toward monthly searches.

response_fields.note: null for enterprise credit-pool or cancelled subscriptions

locations_api.cost: Free. The full list is downloadable at /locations.json. No api_key needed.

params.name: q
params.description: Substring match on location name (e.g. Austin matches 'Austin, TX' and 'The University of Texas at Austin').

params.name: limit
params.description: Max results, maximum 10; default not stated.

response_fields.description: Location id; usable as location in /search.
Audience reach; results sorted by it descending.

response.name: Rochester, MN-Mason City, IA-Austin, MN
response.canonical_name: Rochester, MN-Mason City, IA-Austin, MN,United States

params.name: output
params.description: json (default) or html; json_with_pixel_position (or .json_with_pixel_position suffix) runs Pixel Position on an archived search.

search_archive_api.response_fields: Same JSON (or HTML) as the original search. search_metadata.status is Queued, Processing, Success, or an error. A search can be fetched before it completes.
search_archive_api.retention: Docs: HTML/JSON retrievable up to 31 days after completion. A blog post says searches are stored 30 days. Expired searches return HTTP 410 Gone. Not available with zero_trace.

search_history.ui: My Searches at serpapi.com/searches lists recent searches for about 30 days.
search_history.listing_api: No public listing endpoint is documented; the archive requires a search id. Store every search_metadata.id yourself (the Aira clone must keep its own index).
search_history.retrieval: By id as JSON (default) or HTML; cached/archived retrieval does not consume credits.

status_api.status_metrics_page: https://serpapi.com/status shows 'API Metrics for All Engines': last 30 days, hourly granularity, per-engine selector, average success rate (about 98.8 percent) and average response time (about 1.7s).
status_api.incident_page: status.serpapi.com (launched Jan 2026): incidents and outages, subscriptions by email, SMS, Slack, Microsoft Teams; recommended to subscribe to the API component. Minor bugs tracked on the public roadmap (GitHub).
status_api.aira_equivalent: Aira should compute its own status from local run logs (success rate, p50/p95 latency per engine) and optionally poll the Account API as a key health check.

flow: Send search with async=true; HTTP returns immediately with search_metadata only (status Queued).
Store search_metadata.id for each submitted search.
Poll GET /searches/{id}.json until search_metadata.status is Success or Cached (re-queue if Queued/Processing).
Use output=html for raw HTML, or JSON for parsed results.
Results remain retrievable up to 31 days.
rules: Do not combine async with no_cache.
Do not use async on accounts with Ludicrous Speed enabled.
async_and_webhooks.webhooks: No webhook delivery is publicly documented; completion is by polling. A Bulk Search API (1M+ searches, scheduled=true, 1 to 24h) is on the public roadmap but not available.
async_and_webhooks.polling_advice: Exponential backoff starting at 1s capped at ~10s; treat HTTP 410 as expired.

errors.message: Success with empty results: 'Google hasn't returned any results for this query.'
errors.meaning: Search ran (status Success) but the engine returned nothing; not a SerpApi failure.
errors.advice: Adjust the query/location; do not retry blindly.

errors.meaning: Bad request, usually a missing required parameter.
Account lacks permission, usually deleted account.
errors.advice: Check account status or contact support.

errors.meaning: Resource or endpoint does not exist.
Archived search expired and was removed.

errors.message: Your account has run out of searches. / hourly limit exceeded
errors.meaning: Hourly throughput exceeded or no searches left.
errors.advice: Wait for the hour to reset, enable throttling, add credits, or renew early.
Retry with backoff; email support@serpapi.com if persistent.

errors.message: We couldn't get valid results for this search...
errors.meaning: Search failed before completion (e.g. proxy timeout); not billed.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: No Legal Shield, ZeroTrace or Priority Support.

billing_rules: Only successful searches count toward the monthly total.
Cached searches (identical params within 1 hour), errored and failed searches do not count.
Result volume does not matter: 100 results or an empty result set each count as one search.
Throughput is the guaranteed number of successful searches per hour; spread requests evenly.
Downgrade: renewal date kept, unused searches move to Extra Credits.
Upgrade: pay the price difference, renewal date kept. Cancel: keep searches until renewal.
Out of searches: Auto Renew Early or manual renew refills and resets the cycle.
Refund: full within 7 days unless more than 20 percent of searches used.
Ludicrous Speed costs 2x and Ludicrous Speed Max 4x the Best Effort price; both paid plans only.
Account API, Locations API and X-Ray are free.

sdks.package: serpapi (npm; getJson, getHtml, getMd, getAccount, getLocations, uploadImage)

ui_ideas: Saved queries: name, tag and pin a parameter set per engine; one-click re-run and clone as template.
Run diff: compare two runs of the same query (added/removed/moved organic results, rank deltas, changed snippets) with a visual diff.
Cost estimator: before running, show credits consumed (cache hit = 0), batch cost, and monthly burn projection against plan and extra credits.
Scheduler: cron-style recurring searches (rank tracking, job alerts) with per-schedule budget caps and pause on error.
Export: CSV/XLSX/JSON/Markdown export of any result table or a JSONPath-selected subset, plus 'copy as curl/Python/JS' for every run.
Side-by-side engine compare: run the same q on Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, google_light and show results in aligned columns with overlap score.
Local search history with full-text search over all stored responses, no 30-day expiry, plus tags and star ratings; archive viewer for JSON/raw HTML/rendered preview.
Usage dashboard: daily/hourly charts, per-engine and per-feature spend, throughput gauge with 429 early warning, and cache-hit ratio.
Async job board: queue of async searches with live status (Queued/Processing/Success), auto-poll with backoff, retry failed, and browser/desktop notifications or local webhooks on completion.

Result-to-action pipeline: send job results into Aira Careers (one click to add to pipeline, score against resume, draft outreach), plus a JSON path picker (X-Ray style) that builds json_restrictor strings visually.
